name: Melon aphid
description: Aphis gossypii Glover, the melon aphid, on cucumber.

rules.name: High pressure — warm, dry hour
rules.description: 22-30 C with at most 1 mm precipitation in the hour.

rules.name: Moderate pressure — warm, wet hour
rules.description: 22-30 C with more than 1 mm precipitation in the hour.

_encoding_notes: Kocourek et al. 1994 and Satar et al. 2005 provide the cucumber Aphis gossypii temperature evidence; Davis et al. 2006 is the Myzus persicae comparison.
No humidity condition is encoded: the cited sources give no consistent humidity effect for these aphids on cucumber.
